{{RaceIcon|Draenei}} [[Draenei]] | capital = [[Black Citadel]] | capitals = [[Felstrider Retreat]] | theater = [[Outland]], [[Thalassian Highlands]], [[Felwood]] | language = Darnassian, Thalassian, Common | affiliation = Independent | status = Active | members = [[Tideblade]] |image=Illidari Leaders.webp}} The '''Illidari''',[https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=40079 Shattered Illidari Crest]{{questlong|Alliance|53|They Call Themselves Illidari}} also known as '''Illidan's Forces''',[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/A_Symphony_of_Frost_and_Flame_(WC3_Undead) A Symphony of Frost and Flame (WC3 Undead)][https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Return_to_Northrend_(WC3_Undead) The Return to Northrend (WC3 Undead)] are the servitors of [[Illidan Stormrage]], lord of [[Outland]]. It is composed mainly by [[Blood elf|blood elves]] and [[naga]]. == History == Following the [[Third War]], [[Kil'jaeden]] confronted Illidan and made him an offer he could not refuse. Kil'jaeden was angered by [[Archimonde]]'s defeat at [[Mount Hyjal]], but he had bigger concerns than vengeance. Sensing that his creation, the [[Lich King]], was growing too powerful to control, Kil'jaeden ordered Illidan to destroy [[Ner'zhul]] and put an end to the [[undead]] [[Scourge]] once and for all. In exchange, Illidan would receive untold power and a true place amongst the remaining lords of the Burning Legion. Illidan agreed and immediately set out to destroy the [[Frozen Throne]], the icy crystal cask in which the Lich King's [[Ghost|spirit]] resided. Illidan knew he needed allies to accomplish his tremendous task so he cast a powerful spell and called the [[naga]] to the surface, calling in some old [[Highborne]] debts. A group of naga led by [[Lady Vashj]] emerged from the depths and pledged themselves to him.''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/World_of_Warcraft:_Game_Manual#The_Betrayer_Ascendant World of Warcraft: Game Manual]'' Illidan's attempts to destroy the Scourge ended in failure however, and Illidan retreated to Outland in order to escape Kil'jaeden's wrath. He then began a campaign to oust [[Magtheridon]] from power in Outland, in order to become the shattered planet's new lord. He bolstered his forces by recruiting Prince [[Kael'thas Sunstrider|Kael'thas]]'s blood elves. His forces later discovered a surviving [[Draenei]] village who were also fighting against the Burning Legion. The village's inhabitants, ruled by [[Akama]], swore allegiance to Illidan in return for him liberating them from orcish and demonic oppression. Ever since then, the draenei tribe were officially aligned with Illidan.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Gates_of_the_Abyss_(WC3_BloodElf) Gates of the Abyss (WC3 BloodElf)] A portion of Kael'thas' forces remained on Azeroth, occupying the mountain stronghold of [[Felstrider Retreat]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. Led by Viceroy [[Eldin Sunstrider]], a distant cousin of Kael'thas, the Illidari of Felstrider Retreat remained in the Highlands until the arrival of the refugees of the [[Silvermoon Remnant]]. On the Viceroy's orders, [[Veloren Brightstar]] was tasked to spy on the refugees of [[Brinthilien]] resettling the Highlands.{{questlong|Alliance|5|A Letter from the Royalty}} [[Grand Magister Rommath|Rommath]], a loyalist to Kael'thas, has imbedded himself in the nascent [[Regency Council]] of [[Alah'Thalas]] and has maintained a line of communication between the Prince in Outland and the remaining blood elves in Felstrider Retreat[[Rommath's Orders]]{{questlong|Alliance|9|An Audience With the Prince}} as Kael'thas continued to seek the path to salvation for his people. Meanwhile, more Illidari gathered in [[Felwood]] at the [[Shrine of the Betrayer]], led by the demon hunter [[Faladar Starsplinter]], and naga veterans of Illidan's army, the [[Tideblade]], continue to occupy the [[ruins of Nendis]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]]. ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Night elf organizations]] [[Category:Blood elf organizations]] [[Category:Naga organizations]] [[Category:Draenei organizations]] [[Category:Illidari]]
